summary: The document package provides core functionality for initializing document contexts, defining document structures and models, generating documents, and coordinating building, translation, and rendering processes.
responsibilities: Initializes document base contexts and knowledge paths.
Defines document models, renderers, and output configurations.
Generates documentation based on definitions and project context.
relationships: Document generation utilizes context initialization, models, building, rendering, and translation components.
design_decisions: Modular organization of document generation, context initialization, models, building, rendering, and translation logic.
